description: Search the Jungle Scout product database for Amazon product opportunities. Filter by category, price range, minimum monthly revenue, and maximum review count. Returns estimated revenue, units sold, BSR, and listing quality score per product.

category.description: Amazon category name to filter by. Example: 'Sports & Outdoors'

include_keywords.description: Only include products whose title matches these keywords (or ASINs). Example: ['tonneau cover']

max_reviews.description: Maximum number of reviews (to find low-competition products). Example: 200

min_monthly_revenue.description: Minimum estimated monthly revenue in USD. Example: 5000

page_size.description: Number of results to return (1-100). Defaults to 25.

name: product_database_query
title: Product database query
